rules.content:
title: Wallet Provisioning Following OTP Interception Indicator
status: experimental
description: Detects digital wallet provisioning events where the OTP or verification code was delivered within minutes of a social engineering indicator, such as an inbound call from a suspicious source, a phishi
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: wallet_provisioning
detection:
    selection_provisioning:
        event_type: "wallet_card_provisioned"
        device_first_seen: true
    correlation_otp:
        otp_delivery_elapsed_seconds|lte: 600
        otp_to_provisioning_seconds|lte: 15
    correlation_phishing:
        preceding_event_type|contains:
            - "phishing_click"
            - "smishing_response"
            - "suspicious_inbound_call"
            - "social_engineering_indicator"
        preceding_event_window: 1800
    condition: selection_provisioning and (correlation_otp or correlation_phishing)
level: critical
rules.title: DL-0080: Wallet Provisioning Following OTP Interception Indicator (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: NFC Relay Geographic Impossibility on Contactless Transaction
status: experimental
description: Detects contactless (tap-to-pay) transactions where the POS terminal location is geographically impossible given the cardholder's last known location. When a contactless transaction occurs at a POS te
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: transaction_monitoring
detection:
    selection:
        transaction_type: "contactless"
        entry_mode|contains:
            - "wallet_nfc"
            - "contactless_emv"
            - "tap_to_pay"
    correlation_geographic:
        cardholder_last_known_lat|exists: true
        cardholder_last_known_lon|exists: true
        cardholder_last_activity_minutes|lte: 120
    filter_distance:
        geo_distance_km|gte: 100
    filter_travel_impossible:
        required_speed_kmh|gte: 500
    condition: selection and correlation_geographic and filter_distance and filter_travel_impossible
level: high
rules.title: DL-0081: NFC Relay Geographic Impossibility on Contactless Transaction (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: Ghost-Tap Multi-Terminal Contactless Velocity Anomaly
status: experimental
description: Detects multiple contactless transactions from the same wallet token or card credential across multiple distinct POS terminals within a short timeframe. Normal cardholder behavior produces a maximum o
logsource:
    product: banking
    service: transaction_monitoring
detection:
    selection:
        transaction_type: "contactless"
        entry_mode|contains:
            - "wallet_nfc"
            - "contactless_emv"
            - "tap_to_pay"
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 3
        groupby: "wallet_token_id"
        timeframe: "30m"
    filter_multi_terminal:
        dc_terminal_id|gte: 3
    filter_multi_location:
        dc_terminal_city|gte: 2
    condition: selection and aggregation and (filter_multi_terminal or filter_multi_location)
level: critical
rules.title: DL-0082: Ghost-Tap Multi-Terminal Contactless Velocity Anomaly (Sigma)
